༄༅/ /ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// las nyon shes bya'i sgrib tshogs tshang tshing can// mi shes mun pas sbags pa'i skye dgu'i tshogs// thugs rje'i zer gyi sreg zas zos nas kyang*// 'od phreng snang ba spel byed khyod la 'dud// 'gro gang thar pa'i grong du chas 'dod na// yin rlom zol gyi rdzu bag chos dor la/ */ sgrib gsum sbyong ba'i dag byed 'di ko rnams// gzur gnas blo gros ma rnying gis 'doms shig /de'ang gtsug dgu'i dkyil 'khor du de'i dbang bskur ba mnos shing bsnyen pa thems pa'i rnal 'byor pas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho gas sdig ltung sbyong bar 'dod na gnyis te| rang ngam slob ma sogs kyi ched du bya ba dang*/ gshin po'i phung po sbyong ba gnyis so// dang po ni/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sgo nas slob ma rjes 'dzin yan chad grub par byed pa ni/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas pa ste/ skabs gzhan du ni dang po bdag bum gnyis las mdun bskyed ma byas kyang rung ste sreg chog gi 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa des go chod pas chad pa'i skyon ni med cing*/ long yod na mdun bskyed byas kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin pas sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i ro sreg gi ched du/ lho sgo'i dbang bskur dgos na ma gtogs rang bzhin gyi sbyin sreg gi tshe bdag 'jug ma byas kyang skyon med pa de dag gi rnam dbye shes dgos so// gang du bya ba'i gnas khang rgyal po'i khab bam ba lang gi lhas sogs su ni sa chog mi dgos shing*/ de ltar ma yin pa'i sa phyogs su sa brtag pa 'di las brtag pa sbyang ba'i bar bya dgos kyi bzung ba man chad bya mi dgos/ dang sbyang ba'i bar lhan thabs dpag bsam snye ma nas bshad pa ltar byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sogs su stegs bu mda' gang sor bzhi ngos 'jam par byas pa'i steng du/

thig chen brgyad btab ste/ lte ba'i rgya gram nas phyogs re re nas sgang sor bco lnga re zlum por phyogs re re sor mo bco brgyad re bskor bas thab khung gi shar lho nub byang gi rgyar brkyang khru re 'ong ba'i dbang du byas pa dgos/ bskor ba'i nang nas sor chen po re re ma gsum bskor ba dang*/ thab ngos dang*/ de'i phyir sor chen bzhis bskor ba kha khyer dang*/ slar yang bzhis mchu dang*/ phyir grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thab kyi nang du mu khyud dang ldan pa'i rtsibs brgyad rdo rje'i ra ba can dang*/ de'i phyir lha snam gru bzhi pa'ang bcas pa'i thig btab pa'i rtsibs brgyad dang*/ lte ba so sor gtsug tor dgu'i dang*/ rdo rje'i ra'i phyi'i grwa bzhir sgeg sogs bzhi/ lha snam gyi phyogs re rer sems dpa' re dang*/ grwa bzhir me tog ma sogs bzhi/ lha snam gyi phyi'i phyogs bzhi dang*/ de brgyad du khor yug gi lha'i sa bon mdog mthun gyi tshom bu phyogs re rer bcu bzhi re dang*/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i gtso bo'i mtshan ma'i mdun du raṃ yig dkar po bri/ thab rim gsum dkar dmar sngo ba'i kha khyer dkar po la sngon po'i phreng ba dang*/ mchu la sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma phyir 'phyang ba bcu drug dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dkar por bris pa la zhal khebs dang bcas pa'i steng du/ ba'i lci ba tsan+dan dkar po shug pa sogs rlan dang bral ba/ srog chags med pa/ khang rnying zam shing sogs min pa/ sngar las ma bcol ba gtsang zhing skam pa mar dang 'o ma dri bzang gis sbags pa/ kha khyer gyi steng du dpangs brkyang khru gang gi tshad ldan zlum por bcings pa la/ dkar por bsgyur ba'i nang du me tshang legs par bca' zhing ji ltar 'tsham pa'i bud shing gis gang bar byas/ slob dpon kha shar du phyogs pa'i g.yas su sreg rdzas/ yam shing*/ bal dkar sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba/

srid du sor chen bcu gnyis/ sboms su mthe'u chung gi tshad ldan rlan dang bcas 'od kyi snye ma las/ rnying dang phra dang skyog pa dang*// ring thung lo ma med pa dang*// srog chags kyis zos rul ba dang*// shun bral chag dang bu ga can// rtse mo rno ldan sbom po spangs// rnying pa yin na 'chi bar 'gyur// skyog pos skal pa ngan par gyur// thung ngus rig pa phral du nyams// lo ma med pas na tsha 'byung*// sbom pos phun sum tshogs pa nyams| |skam pas gzhan mi 'dod pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dab dang shun pa ma nyams pa spang blang gi gnad la gzab par bya dgos so// pas mnyam par bcad cing rtse mo me tog gi dbyibs su byas la/ rtse mor sbrang dang 'o ma mar gyis sbags shing*/ sked par dri bzang dang tshon dkar po byugs pa zung du sbyar ba de dag kyang rnying pa/ lci ba/ tshar las/ phra ba/ ring ba/ thung ba/ srog chags kyis zos pa| rul ba/ shun pa dang bral ba/ chag pa/ rdol ba/ kha brag can/ tshad las sbom pa rnams spang bar bya'o// bud shing yang de kho na ltar bgyi ba dag go// nye logs su kha tsha ba dang*| rul ba'i skyon dang bral ba'i rtsi mar gyi khu ba dri bzang gis sbags pa dag dang*/ sreg rdzas gzhan ni/ til dkar nag gang rung*/ yungs kar/ dūrba ni rgya gar nas thon pa rab/ ma rnyed na bod kyi dūrba'i myu gu sngon po rtsa rtse ma nyams pa 'o ma dang dri bzang gis sbags pa dang*/ ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa 'dab ma ma grug pa mar dang 'o ma dri bzang gis sbags/ 'bras chan zho dang mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i zas mchog /'bras dkar po ma grug pa ma bcos pa/ so ba lkog pa dang ma bral ba gra ma med pa/ ma sha dkar po byung na rab/ ma rnyed na nag po/ gro ma grug cing ma rul ba/ nas dkar po ma grug pa kho na dang*/ bilba dang*/ 'bras bu gsum sogs shing tog rigs ji snyed pa rdul dang shing gis ma sbags pa rnams te/ 'bru rnams ni ma rul ba ma nyams pa ma bam pa zhes phub ma dang*/

rdo ba yon gyi slad cung zad kyang med pa kho na/ khyad par tsan+dan dkar po dang*/ pri yang ku/ thang chu/ dri zhim pa'i me tog |'bras yos/ sbrang rtsi rnams snod gcig tu bsham mo// sreg rdzas so sor cung zad re bsres pa dag bya'o// bsham tshul ni/ yam shing*/ mar khu/ til/ yungs kar/ dūrba| 'bras dang zas mchog /ku sha/ so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran// shing thog bcas pa bcu gsum rnams// zhes pa'i sdom ltar mar khu ma gtogs gzhan rnams slob dpon gyi g.yas phyogs su gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du phreng tshar gnyis su bshams pa'i phyi ngos 'das pa'i me lha dang nang ma 'jig rten pa'i me lha ste/ yam shing sogs sreg rdzas kyi mgo slob dpon la bstan la bshams/ g.yas phyogs kyi nye logs su mar khu slob dpon gyi mdun nam/ g.yas su rdo rje/ dril bu/ ku sha dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ rlung g.yab/ snying zho sha/ a ru ra/ sgog skya/ ga pu+ur/ mkhal ma zho sha/ ge sar gsum gur gum la sogs pa/ gla rtsi/ gur gum rnams sbrang dang sbyar ba'i so rtsi/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa/ bgegs bskrad pa'i yungs kar sogs me chas rnams bshams/ g.yon phyogs su stegs dang ldan par dung chos sam nya phyis kyi snod bzhi'i nang du 'o ma dang dri'i chu me tog sna tshogs pa'i zhabs bsil/ dri bzang po'i chur ku sha sogs kyi 'thor g.yab btsugs pa'i bsang gtor/ dri bzang dang ga pur gyis sbags pa'i 'thor 'thung*/ nas dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ me tog dkar po/ ku sha/ til/ 'bras yos dkar po'i chu blugs pa'i mchod yon rnams la dri zhim po'i spos kyis bdug ste/ gtso bo'i sngags sam las thams cad pa'i mthar swā hā btags pas lan bdun sngags pa/ de dag so so'i mdun sogs su bzed zhal re re bzhag /de'i mdun du me tog dkar po ga pur sogs kyi bdug spos/ mar dkar dris sbags pa'i mar me/ tsan+dan dkar po sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bras dkar gyi phye ma 'o mas sbrus pa'i lha bshos/

nyer spyod lnga po me lha dang dkyil 'khor pa'i ched du tshar gnyis bshams/ dkyil 'khor pa dang me lha'i gos zung dkar po dar ram gos kyi kha gru ma nyams pa gnyis dang*/ me lha'i dkar gtor mngar gsum gyis sbags pa rnams bshams/ dus ni sa srod dang tho rangs/ byams pa dang snying rje'i sems kyis khrus byas/ dri zhim pos lus byugs/ gos dkar po dang*/ rin po che'i thor gtsug dang*/ me tog dkar po'i se ral kha dang ldan pas/ 'jam zhing bde ba'i stan la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis shar du phyogs pas 'khod par bya'o// de dag ni sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa dag go// dngos gzhi 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐| zhes rdo rje thogs nas ngag long gtam gyi smra ba bcad la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags brjod cing las bum gyi chus g.yas skor du thab dang yo byad thams cad bsangs/ me lha'i mchod pa cho ga gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mang ngam/ bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gi me las byung ba me snod du bzhag par las sngags dang de'i bum chus bsangs la sbar/ slar yang sngar ltar bsangs la/ bud shing dang rgyu 'dra ba'i shing ngam/ dpal 'bar dang gtsang zhing shing rus pa'i ku sha'i chun po dang lhan cig me sbar ba thab kyi me tshang du bcug la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod de rlung g.yab kyis sbar la/ las sngags bdun brjod cing mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis mchod dgos/ ku sha rnams la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ bdun bzlas te ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa ha cang mi ring zhing mi thung ba gnyis gnyis rtse mo gshibs te/ rang gi g.yon ngos nas g.yas skor du rtse mo shar dang*/ lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang du bstan cing snga ma'i rtse mo phyi ma'i rtsa ba non par thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng du dgram/ sbyin sreg gi yig chung khungs thub thams cad nas ku sha gnyis gnyis rtse mo gshibs te dgram par bshad pa la/

deng sang bla ma kha cig ku sha srad bus rgya gram du bsdams nas dgram pa mthong ba ni shin tu 'khrul pas nongs pa kho nar zad do// slar ku sha chun po che ba zhig ba lang bu ston gyis/ ku sha mang ba zhig ba lang gi mjug ma'i rnam pa dbus rnams dbus mtha' phra ba'i rtse mo shar du bstan pas thab kyi steng nas g.yogs zhes gsungs so// gi rna ba'i rnam pa lta bu byas la rtse mo shar du bstan la thab kyi steng du g.yogs shing*/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa la skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes brjod/ thab dang me bsangs gzi byin bskyed/ sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru bzhi rab tu 'bar ba de'i dbus su oṃ las pad+ma dkar po'i steng du raṃ dang bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i me lha dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum zhi ba'i nyams can spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis spyi blugs dang dbyug gu 'dzin pa/ gsus pa 'phyang zhing sma ra dang ral ba'i tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rnam par sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i sha rgyas shing sku bongs thung ba/ rnam par shes pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrugs shing me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i sa bon gyis snying gar brgyan pa/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i rig ma dang gnyis su med pa zhi ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur par mos la/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas/ hūm̐ ṭa ki dzaḥhūm̐ḥ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod rgyal spros te shar lho nas me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/

zhes mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong srin lag gi bcer g.yob cing g.yon dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya ā bi sha ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'khor bcas byon nas/ me mtshams kyi thab kyi khrod ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ ces mos/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs thams cad suṃ bha nis bskrad cing yungs kar gyis brab/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā raṃ pā d+yaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ zhes chu bzhi phul/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya hoḥ zhes rgya dang bcas pas/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces mos la/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan sor mo gzhan gsum bsgrengs pa rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la dz+wa lā ya sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis dam la bzhag /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas 'di rnams la dbang bskur du gsol| zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/

dbang gi lha rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ ces brjod/ dbang bskur 'di med kyang rung ngo*/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭa kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ lag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya g.yon kha steng du phyogs pas dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba bzung ba'i steng du/ g.yas kha 'og tu lta bas blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ba steng du bstan pa bzhag la/ dgang blugs kyi khar hūm̐ dang me lha'i ljags la raṃ yig gsal ba me lha zhal cung zad gdangs par phul bas gsol bar gyur/ ces mos la/ lag g.yas pus mo'i nang nas phyir mi 'da' bar g.yas skor du 'bul zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya ā bi sha ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ag+na ye/ bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sam/ bdag gi gnas su sbyin pa'i bdag po zhes spos la dgang blugs gsum lnga bdun gang rung phul la me pra brtag /rab bsngags dge ba me yi ltas// dpal be'u dang ni rnga yab gdugs// rgyal mtshan pad+ma bum lta bu// rtse gsum ral gri nya lta bu// bkra shis in+d+ra go ba dang*// rdo rje dung la sogs pa dang*// gang gzar blugs gzar rnam pa dang*// dkar dang 'ja' 'dra mdog sdug dang*// g.yas su 'khyil dang shin tu snum// byu ru dang ni gser mdog 'dra// lug ru dngul dang baiḍūr+ya// nyi 'od 'bar mtshungs dri ma med| |du ba med cing dri zhim pa// pi wang rdza rnga'i sgra ldan mchog /zhi ba kha dog dkar por snang*// rgyas pa la ni gser dang mtshungs// dbang la dbang po'i rtse mo mchog

/mngon spyod la ni sngo nag go// zhi ba'i las la sogs pa la// gser 'dra rtse gcig dam pa ste// rtse gnyis 'bar ba 'bring du bstan// rtse gsum sprin 'dra shin tu dman// du ba che ba mi dge ste// 'bar ka me lce chad pa dang*// rtsub nag pa la sha yi mdog /gsal shing ba lang mgo lta bu// me stag 'phro dang drag po'i sgra/ */ ro yi dri nga mi dge ba// drag po'i las la shis pa ni// de ltar mi dge ba yi ltas// bgegs dang bcas pa nyid ldog ces// gal te bgegs kyi mtshan ma byung na las sngags brjod cing bsang chu gtor/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sngags mthar bgegs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes btags te dgang blugs bdun 'bul/ slar yang sngags kyis bsang gtor byas la/ me lha'i sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun phul lo// me pra bzang na de dag mi dgos/ de nas las thams cad pa'i sngags dang*/ de'i chus sreg rdzas rnams bsangs la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes rdzas rnams bkrus par bsam la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ zhes zhun mar dang*/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ zhes 'bru rnams dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes rdzas lhag ma rnams byin gyis brlabs la/ rdzas lhag pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i skyon thams cad sbyangs nas ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ ces mos la/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing du mos shing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye bdag gi sbyin pa'i bdag po'i sdig sgrib dang khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa me lha'i sngags la sbyar ba'am/ ma sbyar yang rung la spel tshig sngags re rer sbyor nus na rab/ ma nus na sde tshan rdzogs mtshams su sbyar yang rung ngo*// de bzhin du/ oṃ ag+na ye| me lha'i sngags dang*/ na maḥs man+ta zhes pa'i sngags tshan de dag ni dgang blugs kyi sngags yin zhing*/

oṃ ag+na ye zhes pa'i sngags thung 'di ni sreg blugs kyi sngags yin pa phreng ba'i sreg chog 'od kyi snye ma nas bshad pas dgang blugs dang sreg blugs kyi sngags ma nor bar skabs so sor shes dgos so// khyad par 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de ltar rim bzhin dbul te// oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye/ sum cu pa la mar khu me tog ma gtogs pa'i sreg rdzas kyi snod rnams g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas bzung la/ mtheb srin gyis blang la snod kyi 'og nas nang du bskor ba snod kyi steng du slebs zin tshe mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas thab tu 'bul lo/ zhes sa skya pa yab sras kyis dgyes rdor gyi sbyin sreg las byung ba ltar 'dir yang 'thad do// khyad par sdig pa'i gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa = til dang*/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dhi ye/ khyad par bgegs kyi gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa = yungs kar/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe/ khyad par tshe phun sum tshogs pa = dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye/ khyad par dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa= 'bras/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de/ khyad par shes rab dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa= zas mchog /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye/ khyad par srung ba phun sum tshogs pa = ku sha/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye/ khyad par nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa= so ba/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye/ khyad par myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa= nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye/ khyad par nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa= gro/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya/ khyad par lus kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa = sran ma/ oṃ ga gā ni ga gā ni bi lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭaḥ khyad par rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ shing thog rnams 'bul/ sngar bshad pa'i tsan+dan dkar po sogs zhi ba'i sreg rdzas khyad par ba rnams snod logs su yod na me lha'i sngags kyis dbul bar bya'o// de nas chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos sngar ltar mchod nas/

'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod/ yam shing dang*/ ku sha/ dūrba rnams kyi rtse mo lhar bstan cing lag pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas phul la/ 'bru rnams lag pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul lam/ blugs gzar gyis dbul ba gang bde bya bar bshad mod/ 'on kyang mar khu dang gtor ma so rtsi ma gtogs gzhan rnams lag pas 'bu+ul na/ rdzas 'bul ba'i tshe zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal dang*/ yaṃ shing*/ ku sha/ dūrba spos sogs 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bza' ba dang 'bru rnams phyag dang*/ mchod yon dang mar me mdun/ zhabs bsil zhabs/ bsang gtor sku/ me tog dbu/ bdug spos shangs/ dri thugs ka /rol mo snyan la 'bul bar mos/ de nas 'das pa'i me lha'i mchod pa ni/ me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i zhes sam/ me lha'i thugs kar bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i thub pa'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phros pa/ zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar mngon rtog rgyas pa ltar mngon rtogs chog gzhung ltar las gtso 'khor thams cad sku mdog dkar por bsgyur dgos/ ma nus kyang gtso bo sku mdog dkar por nges par bsgyur dgos/ bsgom zhing*/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed nas thab tu me tog dor zhing lha re re'i sngags sham du/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams byon nas thab kyi nang gzhal yas khang rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par mos par bya'o// lha rnams kyi ljags lha rang rang gi mdog can rdo rje rtse de nas mchod pa chog gzhung ltar byin brlabs nas/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun/ sgeg sogs brgyad rnams kyis mchod cing*/ bstod pa bsdus pa sogs mdun bskyed ltar byas nas/ lha rnams kyi ljags lha rang rang gi mdog can rdo rje rtse gcig sbu gu can la raṃ yig dang*/

dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ yig dkar pos mtshan pa re mos la/ gtso bo'i sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun nam/ gsum gang rung phul la/ phrin las gang bcol mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes par mos la/ de nas thog mar gtso bo'i sngags rdzas spel tshig sngar ltar btags pas yam shing nas shing thog sna tshogs kyi bar me lha'i skabs ltar nyer gcig nas stong gi bar sogs ci 'byor pa phul/ khyad par gyi sreg rdzas sogs sngar med pa rnams lha sngags spel tshig sbyar bas dbul/ de bzhin du 'khor sogs rang rang gi sngags la rdzas sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa rdo rje gtsug tor nas khor yug gi bar du gsum nas brgya stong gi bar ci nus pas phul/ rdzas phul nas phrin las bcol ba'i tshe/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pas bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas bsgrub bya/ bdag bsgrub bya zer ba'i 'di bdag gi'am/ yon bdag la sogs ngos 'dzin dgos te/ ci'i phyir na/ bsgrub bya de sgrub byed cho gas bsgrub rgyu dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i go 'phang bsgrubs 'bras de nyid thob pa la 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/ zla ba la gnas pa la khrus byas pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas lus shel sgong ltar gyur par bsam/ de nas slar yang las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun phul nas me tog gi char phab la chu bzhi slar phul te/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swā hā/ zhes so rtsi+e dang*/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar sogs kyis gos zung phul/ de nas nyer spyod lnga dang rol mos mchod nas/ bstod pa gang rung gis bstod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// sogs dang yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskangs/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs| dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying khar thim par gyur ces mos la/

de nas me lhar gtang rag gi mchod pa ni/ las thams cad pa'i sngags brjod cing bsang chus thab dang rdzas rnams bsangs la/ me lha'i sngags kyis sreg blugs gcig phul te/ me lha sku mdog phyag mtshan dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ ces dmigs nas/ chu bzhis mchod cing*| taṃ bu las so rtsi dang*/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu sogs kyis gos zung phul nas/ nyer spyod lnga dang rol mos mchod la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ */ sogs kyis bstod/ me lha'i sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun 'bul/ slar yang*/ sngar ltar rdzas sngags spel tshig dang bcas pas rdzas lhag ma med par 'bul| de nas me lha'i sngags kyis dgang blugs gsum dang*/ gtso bo'i sngags kyis dgang blugs gcig phul nas me lha'i gzi brjid cher 'bar gyur par dmigs/ gtor ma cho ga'i sngon 'gro'i gtor ma ltar byin brlabs te/ me lha'i sngags mthar/ a kā ro btags pa gsum gyis phul nas nyer spyod rol mo lngas mchod/ me de sreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod| |ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol/ cho ga'i tshul ni rang gzhung gi mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu sgrub pa'i ched du ste rab tu gnas pa sogs gzhan gyi ched du yin na/ skabs 'dir slob ma 'di'i lag g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas slob dpon gyi lag g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la lan gsum g.yas skor byas la/ slob mas blugs gzar gyi mgo la g.yas skor gyis 'jus pas sreg blugs lan bdun dang dgang blugs kyang lan bdun dbul du gzhug la/ slob dpon gyis las sngags brjod pa'i srad bu dkar po slob ma bud med kyi lag pa g.yas dang skyes pa'i g.yon du btags pa la las sngags dang de'i chus bsrung*/

yang g.yon du dbul du gzhug go// de nas pra wa ra sat+kā ra'i sngags kyis mchod yon phul/ 'dod don gsol nas| cho ga chad cing lhag pa dang*// ma 'byor yongs su ma mnyes dang*// bdag rmongs 'khrul pas nongs gyur kun// khyod kyis bzod cing gnang bar mdzod// ces dang*/ yig ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis chad lhag bskangs la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub mdzad sreg bya za ba gshegs// ji ltar dngos su slar byon la// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs| oṃ badz+ra muḥ me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying khar thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam/ shis brjod kyis rgyas gdab/ skabs 'dir 'o thug gi cho ga bgyi bar spro na/ phreng ba'i sreg chog 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba ltar bya zhing 'o thug gi ston mo ro sreg la byar mi rung ngo*// long yod na me ma shi ba'i bar rdal dkrug dang 'gom bshang mi bya bar bzhag /long med na 'o ma dri bzang dang bcas pa'i chus me gzhil nas thab kyi thal sol sogs rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung chen por dor/ chu de nas cung zad nang du khyer nas gnas khang khyab par gtor zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na slar bdag mdun bum pa sogs kyi rjes chog gzhung ltar bya zhing*/ sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel yang bdag dang bum pa'i lha la rjes chog sogs gzhung ltar bya dgos/ de ni rang bzhin gyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'o/// / ༈ /gnyis pa de dang 'brel ba'i ro sreg gi cho ga sbyang tshul ni sngar ltar sa chog nas thab 'bri ba'i bar du byas la/ de'i steng du shing khang gi rtsig pa nang khru gang ngam/ ro dang bstun pa'i ji ltar ran pa gru bzhi par brtsigs pa'i phyogs bzhir sgo dang bcas dpangs khru gang par byas pa'i nang gi rgyab phyogs kyi sgo'i g.yas g.yon du shug pa mi'i brla las mi phra ba dri bzang dang rtsi mar gyis sbags pa gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs pa'i steng du/

de gnyis thun mong gis bteg pa'i rdo mchu nang du rngam pa gcig dang*/ mdun gyi sgo nang g.yas g.yon du bshad ma thag pa las yid tsam thung ba'i shing gnyis ma gshib par bslang ba'i steng du/ de gnyis so sor bteg pa'i rdo mchu nang du rngam pa re re byas pa'i shing gi bar rnams su srog chags dang rlan med sogs sngar bshad pa'i sreg chog gi bud shing lta bur mar dang dri bzang gis sbags pa yangs dog ran par dgang*/ de lta bu'i thab kyi steng nas phyir g.yel ba'i kha khyer dang thur du 'phyang ba'i mchu rnams sor chen bzhi pa so so'i ri mo bris pa dag kyang bya ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sreg chog nas dkyus ma'i skabs ltar byas/ de'i steng du ro khang ni/ rab byung la mchod rten gyi dbyibs dkar po/ dge bsnyen la pad+ma dmar po kha sbyar ba'i dbyibs/ rgyal po la sngon po gtsug tor lta bu/ blon po la dmar skya za ma tog lta bu/ tha mal pa pho la ser skya gdan khri lta bu/ mo la sngo skya bim ba'i 'bras bu lta bu/ byis pa la dmar ser lhung bzed lta bu'i dbyibs su bya/ rang la chos 'brel yod pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sogs dam pa rnams kyi pur sbyong na/ shing khang la them skas gsum dang*/ seng khri ba gam gsum dang*/ rmangs dge man chod kyi dbyibs dod par bya zhing*/ ro khang la bang rim bzhi dang*/ bum stan/ bum pa/ bre stan/ bre/ gdugs 'degs/ chos 'khor/ thugs rje'i mdo gzungs/ gdugs/ gdugs kheb/ nyi zla/ tog gi rnam pa mchod rten brgyad gang 'dod kyi dbyibs su bya'o// de ltar gang byed kyang ro khang gi phyi nas thag pa sra mos bsdams la 'jim pa bzang pos zhal zhal legs par byas pa'i phyi sngar bshad pa ltar so so'i kha dog gis bsgyur/ mchod rten ltar byas na mchod rten gyi kha dog so so'i thig rtsa nas bshad pa ltar byug go// de rnams gang la'ang thad du me gsang gi bug pa dang*/

snying khar rdzas dbul ba'i bug pa bya/ gang zag mchog gi pur khang la phyogs dang zur rnams su rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan/ steng du gdugs dang*/ bla bre sogs phyogs bzhir mchod pa'i bye brag sogs bkod legs par bya'o// de nas ro chas su gzhug pa sogs la gnyis te/ dang po phal pa la bya ba'i cho ga ni ro so ma dang dmu chu can lta bu yin na thur ma'i cho gas chu btsags shing*/ ro tshon po la ni thab kyi phyogs gcig nas zhun 'byung ba'i sgo khrol thabs can lta bu byas pa'i 'og tu zhun gzed pa'i snod bzhag /dmu chu la'ang de ltar byar rung ngo*/ */ro skam po dang rul sung can la de ltar mi dgos so// de nas dri zhim po'i chu dang las thams cad pas ro bkrus/ ras dkar po/ snam dkar gyis phyis shing*/ de nas shākya seng ge'i sngags dpral ba/ rdo rje gtsug tor dang rnon po snying kha/ pad+ma gtsug tor mgrin pa/ rin chen gtsug tor lte ba/ sna tshogs gtsug tor gsang gnas/ rgyal mtshan dang gdugs dkar spyi bor| gzi brjid smin mtshams/ sta zur g.yas su sgeg mo/ g.yon du gar ma/ mgrin par glu ma/ rna ltag g.yas su phreng ba/ dpung pa g.yas su shar dang lho'i sems dpa' brgyad/ dpung pa g.yon du nub byang gi sems dpa' brgyad/ rna ltag g.yon du me tog ma/ 'doms su bdug spos ma/ mig gnyis su snang gsal ma/ snying gar dri chab ma/ brla g.yas su lcags kyu ma/ byin pa g.yas su lcags sgrog ma/ byin pa g.yon du 'bebs ma rnams kyi mtshan sngags dang*/ gzhan yang sbyong rgyud las bshad pa ltar dpral ba'i mdzod pur/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba a pā ya bi sho dha ni shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swā hā/ rna ba g.yas par/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba a pā ya sarba satwa bh+yaḥhūm̐/ rna ba g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarba a pā ya bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ mgo'i gtsug phud la/ oṃ traṭa/ dpung pa gnyis la/

hūm̐ re re/ rna ltag gnyis la/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa| sked par/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ pus mo g.yas par/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ g.yon par oṃ sarba bid āḥ bol gong g.yas par/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ g.yon la/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ long bu g.yas la/ oṃ sarba bid swa/ g.yon la/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ sna rtser/ sarba bid hūm̐/ mig g.yas par/ oṃ sarba bid traṭha/ mig g.yon la/ oṃ shā/ gsang ba'i dbang po rnams kyi gnas su/ oṃ bha/ gzhan yang mgrin par dbyangs gsal/ snying gar rtsa rig /lte bar mgron thabs rnams la rtsa rig dang*/ kaṃ ka ni dar ram rgya shog la rab gser/ 'bring mtshal lam gi waṃ li khri/ tha mas kyang snag tsha dri bzang gis kyang sbags pa'i lan+dza'am/ wartu'i gzugs kyis bris pa gnas so sor srad bus bsdams sam/ sbrang ngam/ spyin gyis sbyar la gnas ma 'chol bar bya/ kha cig gis gnas yig rnams phyogs gcig tu byed pa ni shin tu nongs so// de nas rkang pa gshibs shing lag pa thabs 'gel gyis phyag rgya bsnol la ro bsgongs te rab byung yin na/ rtsa rig bzlas pa'i gos dang smad g.yogs bskon/ khyim pa la rtsa rig bzlas pa'i gos dmar po bskon cing rgyan gyis brgyan la/ za 'dre sbub gzhug ni/ gshin po 'drer skyes 'dug zer ba 'byung gis dogs na/ ro'i rkang mthil gnyis nas khab btsugs pa'i rtse mo bol gong gnyis su nyug tsam 'ong bar byas la bzhag /chas 'jug 'di rnams sreg pa'am/ gzhan yang ri la skyel lam/ chu la skyur ba sogs gang la'ang byas na legs so// de nas ro sreg pa'i gnas dur khrod sogs thag ring por 'khyer dgos na/ ro 'khyer ba'i mi thams cad la las sngags kyi srung skud btags/ ro 'khyer mkhan grogs dang bcas pa rnams phyogs skyong rnams su bsam par bya ste/ de'ang gdugs 'khyer ba po ni lha dbang*| rnga yab thogs pa ni tshangs pa/ ral gri thogs pa ni khyab 'jug

/bstod pa 'don pa ni bde byed/ ro'i las byed pa gshin rje/ bum pa thogs pa ni chu lha/ dgang gzar blugs thogs pa ni me lha/ bza' ba thogs pa ni bden bral/ ba dan thog pa ni rlung lha rnams su bskyed la/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril thogs nas gtso bo'i sngags bzla bzhin pas sna drangs/ gzhan rnams kyis sngar bshad phyag mtshan rnams dang rol mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyer la lha rnams kyis kyang mchod pa byed par bsam/ ro bzhag pa'i gnas khang de nyid du bsreg na de rnams mi dgos so/ de nas phung po chas gzhug zin ma thag bdag mdun bum pa gtor ma bdag 'jug ro la lho sgo'i cho ga dang bcas pa rgyas par byas nas/ me sbar gyi gong der ro thab khung sngar bshad pa'i shing khang gi rgyab phyogs shing ring ba rdo mchu gcig yod pa der 'phong bzhag cing*/ mdun ngos kyi rdo mchu gnyis por rkang pa re re bkal la cung zad sgur te bzhag /mi dar ma dgun dus shi ba lta bu yin na chu rgyus rengs nas rdo kha nas 'gyel ba'i nyen yod pas gnyen tshan sogs kyis ma mthong bar byas la chu rgyus gsum man ngag bzhin bcad/ rgas 'khogs kyi ro lta bu dang dmu chu can sogs mi 'tshig gis dogs na ro'i pang du rdza'i bum par yungs kar til mar gyis sbags pas bkang ba dang*/ la cha/ rwa co rnams bzhag ste/ bu ston gyi mi 'khrugs pa'i sreg chog tu rdzas gsum gyi sbyor ba bya ste bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// gsungs pa ni 'di nyid yin pas so// sngar bskon pa'i stod g.yogs smad g.yogs sogs mas rim gyis bshus la ltag pa'i thad du bzhag /dug gis shi ba'i ro yin na mgo la zangs sder bkab la bzhag /ro'i rgyu zhabs su me tshang legs par bcas la bzhag go// de nas sreg rdzas dang mchod pa slob dpon gyi gdan la sogs pa sreg chog gzhung ltar byas la/ cho ga la 'jug pa ni sreg chog dkyus bzhin/ gson cig dgongs shig sogs kyis lte ba'i me tshang nas sbar/

rlung 'ong ba brtags te rlung 'ong ba dang dud ba 'gro ba gnyis kyi sgo phye la gzhan gnyis bkag /rlung chung zhing dud pa 'khyil na sgo bzhi ka dbye/ rlung che zhing me 'ur na sgo bzhi ka bcad/ de nas yam shing dbul ba'i snga rol der/ me lha rdo rje las kyi gtso// tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyong ba dang*// lha rnams tshim par bya ba'i phyir| |'di nyid du ni phrin las mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas/ me lha'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun du tshe las 'das pa bkug /slar yang me lha'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis tshe las 'das pa'i sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad bkug pa ro dang sreg rdzas la bstims nas gnyis su med par byas par bsam la yam shing dbul zhing*/ spel tshig gi tshe so so'i sngags mjug tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dang sa lam gyi bar du gcod pa rnams dang*/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi sdug bsngal gyi tshogs dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa sogs sbyar/ 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa'i tshe/ drang srong chen po me lha ni// sngon gyi dam bcas mna' bor ba// lha rnams zhal ni me yin te// sbyin sreg de ni me la gnas// zhes gsol ba btab la/ 'das pa'i lha bskyed pa sogs dkyus ltar bya/ yam shing 'bul ba'i sngon der ltung ba slong ba'i rgyas/ oṃ sarba a pā ya ā kar+ṣa ya sogs nas/ skyabs su 'gro bzhin par gyur gyi bar brjod/ slar yang*/ sdig pa 'joms pa'i sngags rgya dang sdig pa phral ba'i sngags rgyas/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bkug nas phral te ro dang sreg rdzas la bstims pa ye shes kyi mes gsol bar bsam la/ bcom ldan shākya seng ge 'khor bcas la// tshe 'das lnga phung 'byung bzhi dbang po'i rten// yul gzugs yan lag bcas rnams mchod par 'bul// sngon chad bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang*// nyon mongs las kyi rnam smin sdug bsngal bcas/ */ye shes thugs rje'i me yis rab sbyangs nas// srid dang rnam grol bde ba gang lags pa// dngos grub bde chen myur du bstsal du gsol// zhes brjod la/

yam shing sogs rdzas rnams me lha'i skabs ltar 'dod gsol dang bcas pas dbul te/ tshul 'di ni rgyud las/ mchod pa'i gzugs sam sna tshogs ni// rang rang ngo bos dbul bar bya// zhes gsungs pa ste/ deng sang ro sreg la la dud 'gro'i sha bza' ba'i ched du sreg pa ltar byas nas zhi ba'i sreg chog dkyus ltar bklag pa kho bos mang du mthong zhing thos pa las ches cher 'phags so// de nas rdzas phul nas phrin las bcol ba'i tshe/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas tshe las 'das pa bkug ste mdun du zla ba'i gdan la bzhag pa la/ lha rnams kyis de'i lus la dbang bskur zhing sdig sgrib dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la sogs pa zhi bar byas nas de nyid muṃ las 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi rnam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes bsrungs la/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal bzhin du/ zhes pa nas/ k+ṣe tra gats+tshan+tu swā hā'i bar gyis lam bstan cing sbyang ba chog gzhung ltar las/ khyad par ni tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa dang lha ye shes pa dbyer med du bde ba can gyi zhing khams su me tog pad+ma'i zhes pa ma gtogs spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas thon zhes pa dor/ de nas lha gshegs pa dang*/ me lha'i gtang rag gshegs bsdu sogs dkyus ltar byas la/ long yod na me ma shi'i bar bzhag /long med na dri bzang dang 'o ma'i chus me gzhil la rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya dang*| oṃ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas rus bu bsdus la sāts+tsha'i cho ga dang bcas pas sāts+tsha gdab/ thal sol rnams chu bo chen por dor ba kho na 'thad par sems so// zhes pa ni tha mal pa'i ro mchod rdzas kyi tshul du sreg pa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang dang chos 'brel yod pa'i dam pa rnams kyi pur sbyang ba'i tshul ni/ khrus gsol dang gnas yig sogs sngar ltar byas nas phyag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas pa thugs kar bsnol la/ zhabs sogs sngar ltar bsgongs la za 'dre sbub gzhug sogs mi dgos/

de nas pur la chas gos dang dbu rgyan sogs kyis brgyan nas khri bzang por bzhag la mdun du mchod pa bshams nas/ bdag bskyed dang bum pa gtor ma rnams bya/ sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na mdun bskyed skabs 'dir mi dgos| de nas pur bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed la/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug nas mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar byas la/ pur de lhar gsal ba'i rol mo mchod pa dang bcas pas sreg thab tu spyan drangs/ slar yang pur lhar gsal ba'i gtsug dgu rtsa ba'i lha so bdun po chog gzhung ltar bskyed/ mgron thabs rnams mi dgos/ de nas spyan 'dren rgyas 'debs nas mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya/ yang na gang zag de rang gi lhag pa'i lha 'khor bcas bskyed kyang chog /de nas pur gyi lha ye shes pa dang thugs kar bsgoms pa'i lha tshogs kyi ye shes pa rnams gcig tu bsres la mchod bstod sngon du 'gro ba'i yig brgya dang*/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// sogs kyis ye shes pa rnams gshegs su gsol dgos la/ de ltar ma byas par bzhu na nye ba'i mtshams med du 'gyur te/ gur 'grel las/ de'i snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' 'am rang gi lhag pa'i lha dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang gcig tu bsres nas mnyam pa nyid du gshegs su gsol bar dmigs te/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi gnas su sreg cing sbyang bar bya'o// gal te de ltar ma byas na mchod rten bshigs pa nyid du 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'di ni bla ma min yang sngon nas lha bsgoms pa'i gang zag bzang po rnams la yang byas na 'thad do// de nas sreg chog dkyus ltar las me sbar ba'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis me sbar bar bsam la/ chos 'brel med pa'i mi zhig gis zhabs tog gi tshul du me sbar zhing*/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// zhes pa'i mal du/

dpal ldan bla ma dgongs su gsol// zhes spos la me sbar bas pur gyi lha sngar bskyed pa gsal btab pa bsgom/ ku sha ni bad chen gyi thog du dgram/ 'jig rten pa'i me lhar mchod pa dkyus ltar bya/ sreg rdzas rnams mchod rdzas su bsams pa las/ sngar ltar sdig sgrib dang dbyer med mi bya/ spel tshig gi skabs su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gang na bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi bar du gcod pa rnams dang khyad par gzi brjid sogs sbyar/ 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa'i tshe me lha rdo rje rigs kyi lha sogs dor la chog gzhung ltar bskyed/ de yang pur de dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs su bskyed pa'i dbus su ngo bo bla ma de nyid rnam pa shākya seng ger bsgom/ spyan 'dren nas bzlas pa'i bar dkyus ltar byas nas/ sreg rdzas 'bul zhing bshad ma thag pa'i spel tshig sbyar ba las gzhan pa'i phal ba lta bu'i ltung ba slong ba'i sngags rgya nas myur du bstsal du gsol gyi bar mi dgos/ phrin las bcol ba'i tshe gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis tshe las 'das pa bkug pa/ lhar bskyed la dbang bskur dang lam sbyang bstan sogs kyang mi byed cing*/ zhi ba'i sreg chog gi bsgrub bya zla ba la gnas pa sogs kyi 'don sgom de'ang skabs 'dir mi dgos te/ ci'i phyir na/ bla ma dang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tha mi dad du bskyed pa'i phyir ro// spel tshig gi skabs rang dang chos 'brel med kyang dge slong tshad ldan la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa zhes pa dang*/ gsang sngags 'chang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po yin na/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhes dang*/ rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa la| grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa zhes sbyar/ gzhan thams cad sreg chog dkyus ltar bya zhing*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa yin yang bgres pa'am dmu chu can lta bu la pur 'bar ba'i ched du rdzas gsum gyi sbyor ba bya zhing*/

gzhan ni phal pa'i rigs mi 'gre/ pur sbyangs zin nas me gzhil la steng gi bug par rdo rje rgya gram dang logs kyi bug pa gnyis la rdo rje rkyang pa re re/ sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i gzugs bris pas bcad/ zhag gsum mam bdun mchod pa dang khrus gsol bya/ de nas pur khang dbye la gdung rus rnams bsdus te rten bzhengs su gsol zhing*/ thal sol dang sa rdo rnams lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten bya ba dag go// de dag ni mchog gi gdung mchod gnas kyi tshul du bsregs pa'o// tshul 'di gnyis ni deng sang phal cher dag mchog dman gyi pur la sreg chog gi rnam dbye cher mi shes par shes rlom gyi nyes dmigs ches cher lci ba la sbyor gyin 'dug pa mthong bas/ shes na snyam nas bkod pa kho na'i gnas lugs bya ba dag go// zhes pa'i tshul gnyis phung po sbyong ba'i lhan thabs te/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i ro sreg gi cho ga sdig pa rnam sbyong sogs mkhas pa'i legs bshad khungs thub mang po mthong bas bkod pa yin gyi/ bde mchog lha lnga'i sbyin sreg phrin las rab rgyas dang*/ de'i lhan thabs kyi ro sreg sogs yig cha la la ni khungs thub kyi legs bshad ci yang mi snang bas 'dir ma drangs pa yin gyi/ skyo sngogs sogs kyis ni ma yin no// smras pa/ sgrib gsum srid mtshor ngal ba'i blo dman rnams// bdag yid mkha' dbyings shar ba'i sreg chog gi// mi sbyin skyes 'dis sgrib tshogs rab bsregs shing*// blo gros 'dab brgya bzhad pa cham gcig byas// thos bsam bsgom pa'i las la ma 'bad cing*// spangs rtogs yon tan tshogs dang mi ldan na'ang*// yin rlom dmar ser gos kyi rdzu bag can// ngar 'dzin khengs pas rang nyid bslu ba tsho// lnga par 'gro tshe mi 'gyod cang yod dam// rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa gang de yi// go 'phang thob 'dod rgya la yod srid na// de'i rgyu sgrib gsum sbyong ba nyid yin phyir// sbyong thabs 'di zhes rdo rje 'chang gis bshad// kho bo'i ngar 'dzin chags sdang mthon po'i yid// zang zing khengs grags phyir min rdzogs byang gi// go 'phang 'dod dang 'gro ba mchog rnams kyi// sgrib kun sbyang phyir legs bshad 'di brtsams pas// dus gsum sgrib pa'i tshogs kun rab byang nas// rnam snang rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// de ltar ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od kyi snye ma 'di'ang*/

rang nyid kyi sgrib sbyong dang*/ dad ldan gyi rjes 'jug rnams dang*/ pha rol du son ba'i skyabs bral snying brtse'i yul de rnams kyi sgrib sbyong gi slad du rang nyid kyis bgyis pa'i gtsug dgu'i cho ga'i lhan thabs su dril ba'i sreg chog 'od kyi snye ma/ rje sgam po pas dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i sreg chog ye shes me dpung sogs paṇa grub tshad ldan gyi yig cha mang po dang rgyud kyi dgongs don sor bzhag ste/ mdo khams stod kyi sa'i thig le zla kun dga' tshal gyi chos grwa chen por sbyar zhing*/ slar yang ro sreg gi lhan thabs kyang nyer mkho'i gnas su mthong bas/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas ro sreg sdig pa rnam sbyong sogs legs bshad mang po la gzhi byas te/ shing glang zla ba'i dmar cha'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la/ 'bri gung pa rig pa'i gnas che phra mtha' dag smra ba dge slong chos kyi grags pa zhes sam mi bskyod rdo rjes rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i gnas gdan sa chen po dpal gyi ri bo chen po shān+ta'am dwags lha sgam po'i lha zhol du sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so/// / ༈ /sreg chog 'od kyi snye ma'i sdom ni/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i sdom// bdag bum mdun dang bdag 'jug bcas// sa gzhi brtag bslang sbyang ba dang*// thig gdab tshon bkye bud shing rtsig /yam shing mar khu rdzas 'du bya// slob dpon g.yas su sreg rdzas dang*// mdun du nyer mkho'i yo byad dang*// g.yon du chu bzhi nyer spyod sogs// dus dang rgyan gos stan bco brgyad// gnyis pa cho ga dngos gzhi'i sdom| |rdor dril byin rlabs yo byad bsang*// mchod pa byin rlabs me bsang zhing*// me sbar gso zhing ku sha dgram// thabs dang lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs// bgegs bskrad chu bzhi dbul zhing bstim// dam bzhag dbang bskur mchod cing bstod// sngags ring dag gis dgang blugs dbul// pra brtag ngan na phyir bcos bya// rdzas bsang bkru zhing yam shing dang*| |zhun mar 'bru lhag byin gyis rlabs// yam shing mar khu til yungs dkar// dūrba 'bras dang zas mchog dang*// ku sha so ba nas gro sran// shing thog bcas pa bcu gsum rnams| |dbul zhing mchod la bstod pa bya// dkyil 'khor lha bskyed nas bzung ste// chog gzhung bsrang zhing bstod pa'i mjug

/gtso bo'i sngags kyis dgang blugs dang*// bcu gsum rdzas rnams sngar ltar dang*// phrin las bcol zhing las sngags kyis// dgang blugs dbul zhing me tog 'thor// chu bzhi'i mchod cing so rtsi dang*// gos zung dbul zhing nyer spyod mchod// bstod cing bzod gsol gshegs su gsol// de ltar lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'o// gsum pa mjug gi cho ga'i sdom// thab rdzas bsang zhing me lha yi// sngags kyis sreg blugs gcig phul nas// me lha gsal gdab chu bzhis mchod// so rtsi gos zung nyer spyod dbul// bstod cing me lha'i sngags kyis ni// dgang blugs bdun dbul sreg rdzas rnams// sngar ltar dbul zhing me lha yi// sngags kyis dgang blugs gsum dang ni// gtso bo'i sngags kyis dgang blugs gcig /phul nas gzi bskyed gtor ma dbul// nyer spyod lngas mchod bstod pa bya// phrin las bcol zhing slob ma dag /yod na de don skabs 'dir bsgrub// mchod yon dbul zhing 'dod don gsol// nongs bshags gshegs gsol bsngo ba dang*// shis brjod 'o thug me gzhil zhing*// thal sol dor la byi dor bya// nyer brgyad sbyin bsreg mjug gi sdom// zhes pa ltar lag tu blang ngo*// //
